name: hello
title: Hello
description: The smallest agent: a scripted model, no key needed. Use it to try deploying and running tasks.

name: researcher
title: Web researcher
description: Answers questions by reading web pages and cites its sources. Needs uv for its fetch tool.

name: writer
title: Writer
description: Turns notes and facts into a clear draft. No tools.

name: editor
title: Editorial team
description: Plans a piece, asks the researcher for facts and the writer for a draft, then checks it. Deploy researcher and writer too.

name: support-triage
title: Support triage
description: A webhook receives customer messages; the agent classifies each one and drafts a first reply as JSON.

name: pr-reviewer
title: Pull request reviewer
description: GitHub sends pull request events to a signed webhook; the agent reads the change and comments. Needs a GitHub token.

name: fleet-steward
title: Fleet steward
description: Every 30 minutes, finds failed tasks, reads their logs and reports the likely cause. Read-only.

name: cost-watchdog
title: Cost watchdog
description: A daily report of model spend per deployment that flags sudden jumps and budgets running out. Read-only.

name: approval-triage
title: Approval triage
description: Summarizes each pending approval with a recommendation, so a person can decide quickly. Never decides itself.

name: assistant
title: Console assistant
description: The chat assistant in the console: answers questions about the fleet and makes changes you confirm, with your permissions.
